title: STYLEBENCH: EVALUATING THINKING STYLES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and evaluating a benchmark for reasoning strategies (such as Chain-of-Thought and Tree-of-Thought) in LLMs. The evaluation datasets (GSM8K, AIME, Game of 24, etc.) are centered on logic, mathematics, and general commonsense question answering, without any religious, theological, or ethical components.
